name: chime-sdk-media-pipelines
description: The Amazon Chime SDK media pipeline APIs in this section allow software developers to create Amazon Chime SDK media pipelines that capture, concatenate, or stream your Amazon Chime SDK meetings.

subcommands.name: create-media-capture-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a media pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-media-concatenation-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a media concatenation pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-media-insights-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a media insights pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-media-insights-pipeline-configuration
subcommands.description: A structure that contains the static configurations for a media insights pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-media-live-connector-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a media live connector pipeline in an Amazon Chime SDK meeting.

subcommands.name: create-media-pipeline-kinesis-video-stream-pool
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Kinesis Video Stream pool for use with media stream pipelines.

subcommands.name: create-media-stream-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a streaming media pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-media-capture-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes the media pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-media-insights-pipeline-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified configuration settings.

subcommands.name: delete-media-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes the media pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-media-pipeline-kinesis-video-stream-pool
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Kinesis Video Stream pool.

subcommands.name: get-media-capture-pipeline
subcommands.description: Gets an existing media pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-media-insights-pipeline-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the configuration settings for a media insights pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-media-pipeline
subcommands.description: Gets an existing media pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-media-pipeline-kinesis-video-stream-pool
subcommands.description: Gets an Kinesis video stream pool.

subcommands.name: get-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the specified speaker search task.

subcommands.name: get-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: list-media-capture-pipelines
subcommands.description: Returns a list of media pipelines.

subcommands.name: list-media-insights-pipeline-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists the available media insights pipeline configurations.

subcommands.name: list-media-pipeline-kinesis-video-stream-pools
subcommands.description: Lists the video stream pools in the media pipeline.

subcommands.name: list-media-pipelines
subcommands.description: Returns a list of media pipelines.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags available for a media pipeline.

subcommands.name: start-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Starts a speaker search task.

subcommands.name: start-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Starts a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: stop-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Stops a speaker search task.

subcommands.name: stop-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Stops a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: The ARN of the media pipeline that you want to tag.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes any tags from a media pipeline.

subcommands.name: update-media-insights-pipeline-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the media insights pipeline's configuration settings.

subcommands.name: update-media-insights-pipeline-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a media insights pipeline.

subcommands.name: update-media-pipeline-kinesis-video-stream-pool
subcommands.description: Updates an Amazon Kinesis Video Stream pool in a media pipeline.
